name: Kawasaki W1 / W2 650
engine: 624 cc air-cooled OHV parallel twin, one or two carbs, points
intro: Kawasaki's British-style 650 twin, grown from the Meguro. Pushrods, points and a lot of vibration.

B: It runs points ignition. Clean, gap and time the points before you chase a carb problem.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
